tasks.subject: Task 2: Validation rules for M1 records + auth message
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Validator accepts network-signed bootstrap invites and enforces payload rules for INVITE,

```json:metadata
{"verifyCommand": "`go test ./internal/keys/ ./internal/records/ -v` → PASS", "acceptanceCriteria": ["`keys.AuthMessage(nodeID, nonce, ts)` = `\"otter-auth-v1\" ‖ nodeID ‖ nonce ‖ be64(ts)`", "INVITE authored by `ID16(networkPub)` is verified with the network key; by a user → user key", "Payload rules (each with a test case): INVITE id 32 bytes & expires > 0; INVITE_USED id 32 bytes & `user_id == author`; ENVELOPE `sender_user == author`, `sender_device == 1`, 1–100 recipients, each `user` 16 bytes & `device ≥ 1`, non-empty content (per recipient or shared), total content ≤ 256 KiB, kind ≠ unspecified; ACK 1–1000 ids each 32 bytes; PREKEYS `device_id == 1`, `registration_id > 0`, signed key (if set) pub 33/sig 64, kyber (if set) pub 1000–2000 bytes/sig 64, ≤ 200 one-time keys each pub 33 & owner_node 16", "All M0 tests still pass"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Store — typed appliers, atomic groups, queries
tasks.description:

```json:metadata
{"verifyCommand": "`go test -race ./internal/store/ -v` → PASS", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Every Apply request runs inside `SAVEPOINT req`; any error rolls back only that request", "`ApplyAll(ctx, origin, items)` is all-or-nothing", "DIRECTORY_ENTRY inserts/updates `users` (higher version wins; `entry_key` follows); a different user claiming a taken username → `ErrUsernameTaken`, record not stored", "INVITE inserts `invites`; INVITE_USED sets `used_by` once, else `ErrInviteUnavailable`", "PREKEYS upserts `devices`, replaces signed/kyber, adds one-time keys", "ENVELOPE adds one mailbox row per recipient unless tombstoned; ACK deletes the author's rows, writes tombstones (30 d) and deletes the envelope record when no mailbox rows remain", "MANIFEST inserts into `manifest`", "Queries: `UserKey` (implements `records.UserResolver`), `UserByID`, `UsernameOwner`, `DirectoryEntries`, `Invite`, `Mailbox`, `TakePrekeys` (consumes one own one-time key, returns remaining), `LatestManifest`", "Existing store tests still pass"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: `internal/service` — register, login, submit, prekeys, directory
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Transport-independent business logic with typed errors.

```json:metadata
{"verifyCommand": "`go test ./internal/service/ -v` → PASS", "acceptanceCriteria": ["`Register` checks (in order): complete request; invite exists (`ErrNotFound`); not used / not expired (`ErrConflict`); inviter is the network or an existing, non-revoked member with `can_invite` (`ErrUnauthorized`); directory entry valid (`ErrInvalid`); user not yet registered and username free (`ErrConflict`); prekeys record (author = new user, signed+kyber present) and INVITE_USED (matching invite id) valid; then applies all three atomically and calls `Notify.Directory()`", "`VerifyLogin` checks device 1, |now−ts| ≤ 5 min, user exists (`ErrUnauthorized`), not revoked (`ErrRevoked`), signature over `keys.AuthMessage(nodeID, nonce, ts)`", "`Submit(ctx, user, rec, allowed...)` validates, requires `author == user`, type in `allowed`; ENVELOPE recipients must exist (`ErrNotFound`); INVITE requires invite right; on first application of an ENVELOPE calls `Notify.Envelope` per recipient", "`FetchPrekeys` returns a `pb.PreKeyBundle` (identity from the directory entry); calls `Notify.PrekeysLow` when fewer than 10 own one-time keys remain", "`Directory`, `Manifest`, `Mailbox`, `ImportRecord` (validate + apply, any author) implemented", "Tests cover every error branch listed above"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Gateway (WebSocket sessions) + WSS transport + end-to-end test
tasks.description:

```json:metadata
{"verifyCommand": "`go test -race ./internal/gateway/ ./internal/transport/... -v` → PASS", "acceptanceCriteria": ["On connect the node sends `Event{hello}` (protocol 1, node_id, 32-byte nonce, manifest version, server time)", "Only `ping`, `manifest.get`, `register`, `auth.login` work before login (others → `STATUS_UNAUTHORIZED`); a second login → `STATUS_INVALID`", "Methods: `register`, `auth.login`, `manifest.get`, `directory.sync`, `prekeys.upload`, `prekeys.fetch`, `msg.send`, `msg.ack`, `invite.create`, `ping` — errors mapped to `Status` + message", "After login and whenever a new envelope arrives for that user, the session pushes `Event{envelopes, RecordBatch}` (≤100 per event) containing only entries not yet pushed **in this session**; unacked entries are pushed again after reconnect", "`Event{directory}` broadcast after a registration; `Event{prekeys_low}` to the affected user's sessions", "Frames > 1 MiB rejected (connection closed)", "WSS server routes only the secret path to the gateway; any other path → static site dir or 404; TLS used when cert+key configured", "E2E test (real WebSocket, in-process node) covers: bootstrap register; invite + second register; unauthenticated call rejected; fetch prekeys; send; recipient receives on login; ack removes; reconnect without ack redelivers; directory event; prekeys_low event"]}
```
